gloss: to gush out; to spurt out; to burst out laughing

definitions.gloss: to gush out; to spurt out; to erupt
definitions.explanation: For a liquid, gas, steam, or the like to burst forth forcefully from an opening. Used for sweat, blood, water, lava, and similar.

definitions.gloss: to burst out laughing; to crack up
definitions.explanation: To suddenly and involuntarily start laughing, especially when trying to suppress it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{温泉|おんせん}→温泉：04117_onsen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す。
⟦{火山|かざん}→火山：04020_kazan⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{溶岩|ようがん}→溶岩：13328_yougan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}した。
⟦パイプ→パイプ：00338_paipu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{破裂|はれつ}→破裂：10058_haretsu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{勢|いきお}いよく→勢いよく：26093_ikioiyoku⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}した。
examples.english: The pipe burst and water spurted out with great force.

examples.japanese: ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す。
examples.english: I burst out laughing in spite of myself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{真面目|まじめ}→真面目：01206_majime⟧な⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、つい{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}してしまった。
examples.english: Seeing his serious face, I couldn't help cracking up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{授業中|じゅぎょうちゅう}→授業中：20544_jugyouchuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{笑|わら}い→笑い：02641_warai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧こらえきれず、{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}してしまった。
examples.english: Unable to hold back my laughter during class, I burst out laughing.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: Used both ways ({自他|じた}). Most often intransitive — the substance is the subject (⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す) — but it can be transitive when something forces the substance out (⟦{鯨|くじら}→鯨：04310_kujira⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{潮|しお}→潮：13369_shio⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す). Compound of ⟦{噴|ふ}く→噴く：26557_fuku⟧ (to spew) + ⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧.

USAGE:
Sense 1 stresses a forceful, eruptive emergence. For the "burst out laughing" meaning, the spelling ⟦{吹|ふ}き{出|だ}す→吹き出す：06342_fukidasu⟧ is also common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{汗|あせ}→汗：02173_ase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す: for sweat to pour out
- ⟦{勢|いきお}いよく→勢いよく：26093_ikioiyoku⟧{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す: to gush out forcefully
- ⟦{思|おも}わ→思う：00492_omou⟧ず{噴|ふ}き{出|だ}す: to burst out laughing involuntarily
